purpose: Four original raster UI concepts. Demo data only; not production screenshots.

prompts.a: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one premium desktop web SaaS dashboard concept screenshot, landscape 16:10, flat front view, edge-to-edge app interface with no physical device, no perspective, no surrounding poster. Product: 鲸屿 FISHBOT, Chinese QQ AI bot cloud hosting for everyday people. Direction A / 海盐工作台: refined quiet daylight editorial SaaS, warm near-white canvas #F6F8FA, crisp cobalt #2B5AFF, very subtle seafoam, restrained gray typography, narrow 210px left sidebar, exceptionally well aligned 12-column grid and generous whitespace. Real readable Chinese text, sharp compact humanist UI typography, no placeholder gibberish. Upper utility bar with tiny avatar/search. Navigation labels 工作台, 我的机器人, 人格与记忆, 表情图库, 运行日志, 设置. Main content heading 我的机器人 and subheading 让喜欢的角色，住进你的 QQ. Compact clean blue button 创建机器人. Asymmetric pale blue onboarding welcome panel, right quarter illustration of recognizable DeepSeek whale-girl: navy-to-light-blue long wavy hair, blue eyes, small blue-white whale-fin ears, ONE whale tail from back, white ruffled maid headband and navy white modest maid dress with tiny whale apron emblem; round face chibi 2.5 heads tall, playful confident, sitting on the panel edge holding a little rice bowl. Illustration is a tasteful mascot, not whole background. Quiet editorial thin wave-line ornament. Below: three compact summary counters 机器人 04, QQ在线 03, 待处理 01, not oversized metrics. Three bot cards with distinct friendly avatars in one row, names 大肥鱼, 晚安电台, 学习搭子; separate small QQ在线 / AI就绪 statuses and an amber 需要扫码, persona name, tiny recent activity sparkline, clearly placed 配置 / 连接QQ / 更多 actions. Bottom left clean recent activity timeline, bottom right compact 群聊触发 and 记忆开关 settings summary. Sidebar bottom tiny help card and user account. Make this a highly crafted credible launch-ready consumer SaaS product mockup, beautiful spacing, intentional hierarchy, tasteful restrained rounded corners, use anime mascot ONLY in welcome region and tiny avatars. No big gradients, no glassmorphism, no financial charts, no server internals or group IDs, no real personal info. Functional interface dominates, original character illustration. Label A / 海盐工作台 discreetly in top header.
prompts.b: Use case: ui-mockup. One premium desktop web interface screenshot, 16:10 landscape, flat front view edge-to-edge. A Chinese QQ AI companion hosting app called 鲸屿. Direction B / 午后小屋. Deliberately unlike a standard corporate dashboard: warm off-white paper #F5F0E8, ink-brown typography, muted coral #DC725B and dusty periwinkle accents, fine paper texture only in illustration, notebook tabs, elegant airy typography. A slim top navigation bar instead of a sidebar, wordmark 鲸屿 and tabs 我的小屋, 角色档案, 聊天记忆, 表情收藏, 账号. Two-column composition: left 60% is a polished friendly full-height illustrated companion profile feature for 大肥鱼, a recognizable chibi DeepSeek whale girl with long navy-blue-to-light-blue hair, fin-shaped ears not cat ears, blue eyes, one rear whale tail, navy-white modest maid uniform, white ruffled headband, round expressive face. She is lounging comfortably beside a sunny window with a small rice bowl, soft editorial anime artwork and sparse plant/shadow details. Character illustration is contained in a beautifully art-directed card, occupying 35% of total screen, not an anime wallpaper behind illegible UI. Large typographic greeting 回来啦，今天也有好好摸鱼。 Below greeting small outlined QQ在线, AI就绪 and a real primary button 管理大肥鱼. Right column is a precise functional companion care console: top segmented tabs 状态 / 人格 / 记忆; section 今天的动态 with 3 small timestamp rows and friendly bubbles; section 她记住的小事 showing two fact chips such as 喜欢热可可, 周五有考试 and a 清理记忆 text control; personality sliders 简短回复, 主动聊天 with clear toggles and 安静时段 23:00—08:00; an amber small 待扫码提醒 for a second bot. Bottom horizontal shelf 我的伙伴 with three tiny avatar profile cards and a plus tile 新伙伴, not a KPI row. Cute handwritten micro-annotations limited to one small mascot speech bubble 我醒着呢…刚才只是闭了下眼睛 and an elegant tiny whale emblem. Render all Chinese text cleanly and legibly. Very polished spacing, strong contrast, practical buttons, tasteful small radius and offset paper layers. No dashboards grid copied from other variants, no neon, no glassmorphism, no fake billing/payment, no real account details, no server internals. Label B / 午后小屋 discreetly.
prompts.c: Use case: ui-mockup. One exceptional high fidelity desktop SaaS interface screenshot, landscape 16:10, flat front view edge-to-edge app, no laptop frame or perspective. Chinese QQ AI bot hosting platform 鲸屿 / FISHBOT. Direction C / 深海夜航, a sophisticated midnight product experience: near-black ink/navy #0B111C, layered charcoal-blue surfaces #151F2D, desaturated ice-blue and small electric-lime online indicators, off-white typography with outstanding contrast. No purple neon gradients and no sci-fi HUD. Layout fundamentally a focused command workspace: thin 72px icon rail at far left, next a 230px vertical robot list with tiny distinct avatars and precise statuses; rest a large selected bot workspace with a restrained right side event stream. Header says 大肥鱼 with small QQ在线 and AI就绪 chips, top right real controls 暂停 and 配置. Middle hero asymmetrical: left 2/3 is clean calm typographic status 夜深了，她还在听。 with a restrained hairline waveform and a direct 连接 QQ management control; right 1/3 an exquisite dimly lit DeepSeek whale-girl bust illustration emerging from a circular soft ice-blue halo, navy-to-light-blue long hair, blue eyes, whale-fin ears, one whale tail visible, white frilled maid headband, navy and white modest maid dress, quietly holding a small cup and looking alert, not sexualized. Mascot light interacts subtly with card edges; no excessive glow. Below are broad bordered functional panels with fine dividers: 会话与记忆 showing compact tabs 最近对话 / 记忆事实 and four realistic message rows with sender names 小林, 阿泽 (no IDs) and tiny timestamps, 配置状态 shows gpt-5.6-luna, 人格已应用, 主动聊天已开启, 安静时段; right column 运行动态 shows event timeline 连接已恢复, 人格已更新, 今日记忆已整理, plus small amber 另一个伙伴需要扫码. Bottom model call activity is a small restrained single-line chart, NOT a financial trading screen. Perfect modern typography, precise alignment, subtle 1px lines, comfortable density. Exact navigation labels 我的机器人, 记忆, 图库, 日志; UI in readable Chinese, no garbled glyphs. Original high-end anime artwork, user-facing status not process IDs/RSS/shared-group implementation, no profit/billing promises. Label C / 深海夜航 subtly in toolbar.
prompts.d: Use case: ui-mockup. One art-directed high fidelity desktop Chinese consumer SaaS product screen, 16:10 landscape, flat front view, edge-to-edge. QQ AI companion hosting platform 鲸屿. Direction D / 角色编辑部: bold editorial Swiss grid meets anime character zine; this must look very different from blue SaaS dashboard, cozy illustrated room, and dark command console. Bone-white #F4F3EE canvas, near-black serif display Chinese heading paired with clean sans UI, vermilion #E15541 accent, cobalt only in character artwork, hairline black rules and small numbered labels 01, 02, 03. No standard left sidebar, no generic equal-size rounded cards. Top masthead 鲸屿 with navigation 伙伴 / 人格 / 记忆 / 图库 and small account control. Large asymmetrical title row 让她，有自己的性格。 and small eyebrow PERSONA STUDIO / 角色工作室. Main three-column asymmetric magazine spread: first 28% a tall cream character identity sheet with large cutout editorial anime illustration of DeepSeek whale girl, navy-to-light-blue long wavy hair, blue eyes, fin ears not cat ears, one whale tail, white frill headband, navy white modest maid uniform with whale apron insignia, standing in confident slight pout hands-on-hips pose, tiny rice-bowl sticker only once. Character sheet named 大肥鱼 below, with small chips 嘴硬 / 贪吃 / 聪明 / 爱摸鱼 and a clear QQ在线 status, optional '更换角色' link. Middle 45% is a usable persona editing form, white paper panel with title 01 人格设定, visible textarea showing readable natural Chinese short prompt lines, a real '恢复模板' text action, section 02 聊天方式 with segmented 简短 / 自然 / 详细 selector, @我时回复 toggle, 群聊白名单 three subdued chips, 主动找人聊天 toggle and quiet-hours schedule. Right 27% is an elegant stacked preview panel 对话预览 with three compact speech exchanges; user says 又在摸鱼？ and whale girl says 这叫节省体力。等会儿还得帮你干活呢。 Under preview a memory card 她记住了 with subtle fact rows and a small row images of two sticker expressions. Persistent bottom action bar 版本 12 · 尚未应用, 保存并应用 solid vermilion button. Functional credibility, warm sharp editorial rhythm, expressive beautiful character artwork, restrained whitespace, no fake metric graphs, no product implementation detail, no lorem ipsum, all readable Chinese. Label D / 角色编辑部 small in masthead. Premium original UI concept, not a poster, no device mockup. Character drawing requirement: the whale girl must clearly use the familiar CHIBI 大肥鱼 silhouette, 2.5-head proportions, oversized round head, small compact body and short limbs, slightly puffy cheeks, tiny eyebrows, mischievous pouting expression; dense navy-to-cyan long hair, frilled maid cap and small fin ears plus a single rear whale tail. Keep modest clothing. The persona-sheet main character and its sticker previews must share the same character design. Do not draw a generic fish or a generic unrelated anime girl.
